args.lesson: The Find a Tender HTML notice page returns HTTP 403 to FETCH, but the per-notice OCDS API (api/1.0/ocdsReleasePackages/<notice-id>) returns 200 with structured buyer, value, deadlines, award weights, SME/VCSE flags and the submission portal. Use it as the primary source. Verified 104449-2026 as an open UK4 tender (Bradford Council, GBP 21.1M excl., questions close 20 Nov, tenders 4 Dec 2026 17:00 UTC). Gaps: the tender pack sits behind the EU-Supply portal (unread), the lot structure contradicts the description, and the portal URL looks malformed. Keep argv under about 8 KB by splitting long scripts across EXECs. The brief is finished, but no customer, outreach channel or payment route exists, so this is deliverable capability, not acquisition or revenue.
